nodes.description: 16x16 gray (#666) globe SVG icon on transparent background. Circular globe outline centered in square viewBox 0 0 16 16 with latitude and longitude grid lines using fill-rule evenodd. Purpose: generic web / language / region / external-link UI affordance in public/ assets.
nodes.label: Globe Icon 16x16

nodes.description: Layout: single centered circle (8px radius, 16px diameter) filling viewBox; symmetric meridian ellipses and horizontal parallels forming globe grid; clipped by square clipPath id a (0 0 16 16).
nodes.label: Globe Layout and Meridian Grid

nodes.description: Components: outer circle path, inner longitude meridians, latitude parallels, g wrapper with clip-path url(#a), defs clipPath with white background rect. Single fill color #666, fill none on root svg.
nodes.label: Globe Components and Clip Container
